decision: The complete q8192/out512 boundary passes at 56050.9289 ms, versus 53818.8428 ms for the qualified compact-normalization baseline. All 512 tokens and callbacks and the first raw logit match GB10. The observed 2232.0861 ms increase provides no reason to enable this route. Keep CertifiedDotTiles=0 and the qualified 8f436db MoE. Native 86079 dots match the independent original CPU algorithm; 161050 tiles exercise the certificate. The real-model admission density was not instrumented. Static staged-gate instructions rise from 454 to 623 and the maximum referenced VGPR from 41 to 46, without scratch instructions; these are diagnostic counts. One negative microtiming is invalid. One run per configuration does not establish repeatability. Broader contexts, renewed package/HTTP/soak and immutable performance remain open.
